record.dic_text:
08073 Shamlay {sham-lah'-ee}

08014 的另一型; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Shalmai 1; 1

薩買 = "我的衣服"
1) 薩買的子孫所成的家族, 負責在聖殿服事的僕役, 他們隨著所羅巴伯由被擄之地回歸 (#拉 2:46|)

08073 Shamlay {sham-lah'-ee}

for 08014;; n pr m

AV - Shalmai 1; 1

Shalmai = "my garments"
1) a family, descendants of Shamlai, of temple slaves who returned
   from exile with Zerubbabel
